findings.highlight: Saber got Berserker away from here
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーは身を挺して俺からバーサーカーを引き離してくれた
findings.governingReading: Saber put herself bodily in harm’s way to draw Berserker away from me
findings.explanation: The branch-specific rationale omits both Saber’s self-sacrifice and the fact that she drew Berserker away from Shirou.

findings.evidenceJa: 在りもしない追っ手の影
findings.governingReading: the shadow of a pursuer who was not even there
findings.explanation: Shirou’s irrational fear of an imaginary pursuit becomes fear of a real but unidentified pursuer.

findings.highlight: The people that were here until a few hours ago. The people who were by my side until a few minutes ago
findings.evidenceJa: ほんの数時間前までこの部屋にいた誰か。 ほんの数分前まで俺の傍らにいた誰か
findings.governingReading: Someone who was in this room only hours ago. Someone who was beside me only minutes ago
findings.explanation: Two individually evoked absent people become plural groups, weakening Shirou’s focus on Rin and Saber.

findings.highlight: A sharp pain runs through my left hand
findings.evidenceJa: 鈍い痺れが走って消えた
findings.governingReading: a dull numbness runs through the back of my left hand and vanishes
findings.explanation: The Command Spell sensation changes quality, location, and completion: numbness becomes sharp pain and its disappearance is omitted.
Shirou’s emotional impulse is rewritten as instinct, changing the characterization of his decision to return.

findings.highlight: I can tell there’s someone in front of me, the one who stabbed my heart, but I can’t see very clearly
findings.evidenceJa: 見えているのに見えていない
findings.governingReading: I can see the thing before me, the thing that pierced my heart, yet I cannot perceive it
findings.explanation: A paradoxical failure to recognize what is visibly present becomes ordinary blurry eyesight, and the unknown thing becomes a person.

findings.highlight: will be killed the instant Saber is lost
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーを失った時点で殺される
findings.governingReading: once Saber is lost, Emiya Shirou will be killed
findings.explanation: The point after which Shirou is defenseless becomes an assertion of instantaneous death.

findings.evidenceJa: 俺は一人になってしまった
findings.explanation: The consequence of abandoning his protectors becomes a deliberate act of social withdrawal.

findings.highlight: my life was lost as well
findings.evidenceJa: 俺の命は終わっていたようなもの
findings.governingReading: my life was already as good as over
findings.explanation: Shirou’s retrospective judgment about survival prospects becomes a literal simultaneous loss of life.
